author: Newport Daily Express
title: Miss Turkic Announces International Cultural Pageant for Turkic Women
text:
Miss Turkic introduces an international pageant connecting cultural heritage, women’s leadership, and representation across the Turkic world while creating opportunities for participants to serve as cultural ambassadors on global stages.
United States, July 30, 2026 -- Miss Turkic Establishes an International Cultural Platform
Miss Turkic has announced the development of an international beauty pageant created to provide Turkic women with a platform for cultural representation, leadership, education, and international engagement.
Founded by Aika Iskakova, the initiative is designed to bring together participants from Turkic countries and communities while highlighting the languages, traditions, histories, and cultural identities represented across the Turkic world.
The pageant is structured around the belief that international competitions can serve a broader purpose beyond personal recognition. Miss Turkic will provide participants with opportunities to present their heritage, share their experiences, develop leadership skills, and represent their communities before international audiences.
Aika Iskakova Draws From International Experience
Iskakova is a former international model, beauty pageant participant, and cultural producer originally from Kazakhstan. Her professional background includes work in the international fashion industry and participation in New York Fashion Week and other prominent fashion events in the United States.
She also represented Kazakhstan in national and international beauty pageants. These experiences gave her direct knowledge of how pageants operate, how participants prepare for international competition, and how global platforms can influence public understanding of a contestant and her country.
Her work across fashion, media, and pageantry also prompted her to consider how international competitions could place greater emphasis on culture, education, leadership, and meaningful representation.
“Having participated in international beauty pageants and worked in the fashion industry, I saw how powerful these platforms can be,” Iskakova said. “I wanted to create something that goes beyond appearance: a platform where women can represent their heritage, speak about their culture, and become the voice of a new generation.”
Expanding the Role of Pageant Participants
Miss Turkic was created to recognize participants not only for their presentation on stage, but also for their ability to communicate the values, traditions, and contemporary perspectives of their communities.
The pageant’s framework identifies participants as potential cultural ambassadors who can introduce international audiences to the diversity of Turkic peoples. Education, communication, personal development, and respect for cultural roots will form important parts of the participant experience.
Through this approach, the organization aims to encourage contestants to explore their identities and articulate what their heritage means within a modern international setting. Participants will be able to share cultural stories, discuss traditions, and contribute their perspectives on the changing role of Turkic women.
The initiative also recognizes that the Turkic world includes countries, distinct peoples, and diaspora communities with different histories and experiences. Miss Turkic intends to create a shared platform where those differences can be presented while strengthening connections based on linguistic, historical, and cultural ties.
Miss Turkic Recognized Among the Best in 2026
Miss Turkic has recently been recognized as the Best International Beauty Pageant in New York of 2026 by Best of Best Review , acknowledging the organization's contribution to international pageantry and cultural representation. The recognition reflects the pageant's mission of celebrating heritage, leadership, and cross-cultural understanding while providing women with a platform to represent their countries on the global stage.
The award also highlights how Miss Turkic has distinguished itself by placing cultural identity at the heart of international competition. Under Aika Iskakova's leadership, the organization has continued to promote the traditions, languages, and values of Turkic communities while encouraging participants to become ambassadors for their heritage, reinforcing the pageant's growing reputation within the international beauty and cultural events industry.
Supporting Leadership and International Dialogue
Women’s leadership is another central element of the platform. Miss Turkic is intended for women who seek to represent their cultures responsibly, engage with international communities, and use public visibility to support constructive dialogue.
The organization views cultural representation as a responsibility that requires preparation, knowledge, and respect. Contestants will be encouraged to understand the communities they represent and communicate their cultural identities accurately and thoughtfully.
Miss Turkic also aims to support cultural exchange among Turkic countries and Turkic diaspora communities in the United States. By bringing participants and audiences together, the organization seeks to contribute to stronger international connections through fashion, art, media, and public engagement.
The official Miss Turkic platform includes information for prospective participants, media organizations, sponsors, and strategic partners interested in supporting the pageant’s cultural and educational objectives.
Building a Contemporary Image of Turkic Women
Iskakova’s founding vision is centered on presenting a contemporary and multidimensional image of Turkic women. The platform is designed to acknowledge beauty while giving equal importance to education, cultural awareness, confidence, communication, and leadership.
This direction reflects her experience within pageantry and fashion, where she observed both the professional opportunities these industries can create and the limitations of programs that focus primarily on appearance.
By establishing Miss Turkic, Iskakova is applying her experience to a platform intended to celebrate cultural identity while creating opportunities for women to develop as public representatives. The initiative will connect pageantry with intercultural dialogue and provide a structured setting for participants to share the traditions and perspectives of their communities.
As the organization develops its international network, Miss Turkic will continue inviting participation from women of Turkic origin and exploring relationships with cultural institutions, media organizations, and partners aligned with its mission.
About Miss Turkic
Miss Turkic is an international beauty pageant for Turkic women founded by cultural producer and former international model Aika Iskakova. The platform brings together culture, fashion, education, women’s leadership, and intercultural dialogue. It was created to help participants represent their countries, communities, languages, and traditions while developing as cultural ambassadors on the international stage. Miss Turkic is operated by Turkic Media Group LLC, based in Miami, Florida. Partnership and organizational inquiries may be directed to ceo@missturkic.net , while general questions may be sent to info@missturkic.net .
